marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 為什麼有些國家愈救愈窮? = THE DIVIDE : A Brief Guide to Global Inequality and its Solutions | Wei shen me you xie guo jia yu jiu yu qiong? = THE DIVIDE : A Brief Guide to Global Inequality and its Solutions

This book traces how the definition of "development" has evolved in the eyes of global economic powers — from Columbus's expeditions in the 1490s to the modern international debt system. It explores how a handful of wealthy nations gradually became powerful enough to influence and control the economic policies of other regions around the world. Drawing on groundbreaking research, in-depth analysis, and the author's firsthand experience living in the Global South, the book offers a series of thought-provoking challenges to mainstream perspectives on global inequality — along with potential solutions
